# Evaluation report (generated by scripts/run_eval.py, do not edit)

Synthetic customers of the fictional operator Halvorsk Mobile. Models learn from a past randomised campaign over 12,000 customers; policies are scored on a call queue of the 150 highest-risk customers out of 2,000 held-out customers, using the simulator's true expected value of each offer (two years of margin saved minus offer cost). Queue churn drivers: {'device': 20, 'network': 14, 'none': 30, 'price': 55, 'relocation': 7, 'service': 24}; 12 queue notes carry an injected instruction. Churn model AUC on simulated outcomes: 0.6457 (account data), 0.6936 (plus note keywords). Values are in synthetic currency units.
